items.headline: $THEO Crashes 92% After Suspected Base Bridge Exploit
items.summary: Autheo's $THEO plunged 92% after a suspected bridge exploit minted 19M tokens that were dumped on Base. The team urged users not to buy, sell or bridge the token.

items.headline: $MNX Launches Futures on AI Lab IPOs and Revenue
items.summary: $MNX rolled out leveraged futures tied to AI lab IPO filings, private valuations and revenue estimates — a fresh DeFi use case for synthetic exposure.

items.headline: StarkWare Launches Shadow Accounts on Starknet, $STRK
items.summary: StarkWare launched Shadow Accounts on Starknet, letting apps hold DeFi positions under separate persistent identities. A new privacy-flavored primitive for the $STRK ecosystem.

items.headline: $SUI Logs First Native Quantum-Safe Devnet Transaction
items.summary: Mysten reported Sui's first native quantum-safe devnet transaction using ML-DSA-65 signatures, with mainnet support targeted for Q1 2027. Big long-term security milestone for $SUI.

items.headline: $BLUR Sinks 20% as NFT Marketplace Shuts Frontend
items.summary: Blur will shut down its frontend next month as NFT volumes dwindle, though the protocol stays onchain. $BLUR fell more than 20% on the news.
